      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "name": "memory_limit",
      "scope": "GLOBAL"
    },
    {
      "default_evidence": "If your query reads a large amount of data from a file or writes a large amount of data, try setting the `preserve_insertion_order` option to `false`: `SET preserve_insertion_order = false`.",

      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "name": "preserve_insertion_order",
      "scope": "GLOBAL"
    }
  ]
}
